claims: Germany and Austria were historically linked within the Holy Roman Empire.
Germany and Austria were historically linked within the Austro-Hungarian Empire.
The Anschluss in 1938 saw a forced union.
Germany and Austria have operated as distinct nations since 1945.
Germany defeated Austria 5-1 in April 2026 World Cup Qualifiers.
Germany defeated Austria 6-0 in a 2025 UEFA Nations League match
